name: namespaced class name
code:

namespace App\Models;
class User { public function name() { return "u"; } }
$u = new User();
echo get_class($u), "|", $u->name(), "|", User::class, "|", __NAMESPACE__;

code:

echo Cart::MAX, "|", Cart::size(), "|", Cart::$count, "|", \Shop\Cart::MAX, "|", namespace\Cart::size();

name: global namespace block
code:

namespace First { function who() { return __NAMESPACE__; } class K {} }
namespace { function who() { return "global"; } echo who(), "|", First\who(), "|", \First\who(), "|", get_class(new First\K()), "|", (__NAMESPACE__ === "" ? "empty" : "set"); }

name: type declarations resolve in namespace
code:
<?php
namespace Geo;
interface Shape { public function area(): float; }
class Sq implements Shape { public function __construct(private float $s) {} public function area(): float { return $this->s * $this->s; } }
function show(Shape $s): string { return get_class($s) . ":" . $s->area(); }
function pick(bool $b): ?Shape { return $b ? new Sq(2) : null; }
echo show(new Sq(3)), "|"; var_dump(pick(false)); echo get_class(pick(true));

name: inheritance across namespaces
code:
<?php
namespace Base { abstract class Animal { abstract public function sound(): string; public function speak() { return static::class . " says " . $this->sound(); } } }
namespace Pets { use Base\Animal; class Dog extends Animal { public function sound(): string { return "woof"; } } class Puppy extends Dog {} echo (new Dog())->speak(), "|", (new Puppy())->speak(), "|"; var_dump(new Puppy() instanceof Animal, new Puppy() instanceof \Base\Animal); }
expected:
Pets\Dog says woof|Pets\Puppy says woof|bool(true)
bool(true)

name: interfaces and traits in namespace
code:
<?php
namespace Mix;
interface Named { public function name(); }
trait Greets { public function hi() { return "hi " . $this->name(); } }
class P implements Named { use Greets; public function name() { return "p"; } }
$p = new P(); echo $p->hi(), "|"; var_dump($p instanceof Named, $p instanceof \Mix\Named);

name: exceptions in namespace
code:
<?php
namespace Errs;
class AppError extends \RuntimeException {}
function risky() { throw new AppError("bad"); }
try { risky(); } catch (\LogicException $e) { echo "wrong"; } catch (AppError | \TypeError $e) { echo get_class($e), ":", $e->getMessage(); }
try { throw new \InvalidArgumentException("i"); } catch (\Exception $e) { echo "|", get_class($e); }

name: class name strings and callables with namespaces
code:

namespace Dyn;
class Tool { public static function run($x) { return "ran" . $x; } public function go() { return "go"; } }

name: closures and use clause unaffected
code:
<?php
namespace Cl;
$base = 10;
$add = function($x) use ($base) { return $x + $base; };
$mul = fn($x) => $x * $base;
echo $add(1), "|", $mul(2), "|", (function() use (&$base) { $base++; return $base; })();
